summary: Fixed the flaky PH-291 HTTP test without touching product code. The old assertion `assertNotContains(response, 'C8')` used a 2-character contract code that randomly collides with CSRF/hex tokens in the rendered HTML, which made the PH-281 PR first CI run fail and the retry pass. The test now creates the hidden finance-project contract with the unique long code `CT-HIDDEN-C8-9f3a`, asserts the full code is absent, and additionally verifies the derived payload: pm sees exactly one pending contract change, pm refs include the visible change and exclude the hidden finance-project change, while owner sees the second change and its ref; the original `cash_not_scoped_to_project` and pm-scope business assertions are preserved. No product code, migration, settings or other test was changed; the HTTP test passed three consecutive scoped runs. The task risk became S via the PH-307 planning slot because its whitelist includes governance critical-path files (tasks.json/manifest.json), which verify-change requires to be risk S at BASE.
